title: Fusion MCP agents querying assemblies like a CAD database
summary: Rina argues MCP-style agents in Autodesk Fusion can search messy assemblies, isolate fasteners, param-edit screw sizes, and re-layout hardware from English—treating existing CAD as a queryable database rather than greenfield text-to-3D.
question_it_answers: Why is MCP-over-existing-CAD assembly search bigger than text-to-3D part generation?

claims.text: The described Fusion workflow finds fasteners in a large assembly, hides everything else, and changes dimensions across screw sizes from plain English.
claims.evidence: find specific fasteners inside a large assembly, hide everything else, change dimensions across different screw sizes
claims.subject: ai-cad-hardware

claims.text: MCP-style agents that understand existing engineering data can automate find-filter-param-pattern work on live assemblies.
claims.evidence: once MCP-style agents can reliably understand what is already inside a real engineering project, the boring half of CAD work starts looking suspiciously automatable.
claims.subject: ai-cad-hardware

judge_hints.why_must_read: Assembly-query interface for keyboard PCBs and BESS skid models already in CAD.
